title: Can I MASTER Seirawan Chess?
summary: chess.com Seirawan Chess (S-Chess) revisited vs online humans, including a titled FIDE Master rated 1900 in the variant: each side has an Elephant (rook+knight) and a Hawk (bishop+knight, he sometimes calls it the eagle) in reserve, dropped onto the square a back-rank piece vacates on its first move. Goal: win five games; he wins five and counts a strong game vs the FM as a half point ('five and a half points').
rules: Standard starting position; each player additionally holds one Elephant and one Hawk in reserve.
Elephant moves as rook + knight; Hawk moves as bishop + knight.

When a piece on your back rank moves for the first time, you may immediately place one reserve piece on the square it just left (gating). When castling you may gate onto either the king's or rook's vacated square (S-chess rule, inferred).
Once all original back-rank pieces have moved, reserve pieces that weren't gated can no longer enter (S-chess rule, inferred).
Pawns may promote to Elephant or Hawk too (inferred).
win_condition: Checkmate. Series goal: 5 wins (+ one drawn game vs an FM).
